parameters.content:
## LLM - Call Messages (Multi-Provider BYOT)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/llm-call-messages

**Description:** Appel LLM synchrone multi-provider avec pattern BYOT (Bring Your Own Token).

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["provider", "model", "api_key", "messages"],
  "properties": {
    "provider": { "type": "string", "enum": ["anthropic", "openai", "mistral", "google", "ollama-cloud"] },
    "model": { "type": "string", "description": "Model ID (ex: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, gpt-4o)" },
    "api_key": { "type": "string", "description": "API key for the provider (REQUIRED, no fallback)" },
    "system": { "type": "string", "description": "System prompt" },
    "messages": { "type": "array", "description": "Messages array [{role, content}]" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "default": 4096 },
    "temperature": { "type": "number", "default": 0.7, "minimum": 0, "maximum": 2 },
    "surface": { "type": "string", "description": "Surface catalogue : responses → /v1/responses (OpenAI). Absente → chat/completions" },
    "web_search": { "type": "boolean", "default": false, "description": "Recherche web native, traduite par n8n. Fournisseur non câblé → 422 web_search_unavailable" },
    "metadata": { "type": "object", "description": "Passthrough metadata" }
  }
}
```

**Providers supportes:**
- `anthropic` → Claude (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, etc.)
- `openai` → GPT (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, etc.)
- `mistral` → Mistral (mistral-large-latest, mistral-medium, etc.)

**BYOT Pattern:** api_key est OBLIGATOIRE. Aucun fallback sur les variables d'environnement.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const d = $json; const msgs = []; if (d.system) msgs.push({ role: 'system', content: d.system }); msgs.push(...(d.messages || [])); const c = { model: d.model, messages: msgs, max_tokens: d.max_tokens }; if (d.temperature !== undefined && d.temperature !== null) c.temperature = d.temperature; return c; })()) }}
